# QuickSathi

> QuickSathi (operated by Alomonx Technology Pvt. Ltd.) is an online service booking platform in India connecting customers with verified, trusted on-demand service professionals nationwide.

## Core Services & Offerings
- **Wedding & Event Services**: Certified Vedic Pandits & Acharyas for Vivah Sanskar, Griha Pravesh, Hawan, candid wedding photography, cinematic wedding films, drone shoots, stage decoration, catering, and bridal makeup.
- **AC & Appliance Repairs**: Doorstep split and window AC repair, deep foam jet servicing, gas refilling, refrigerator, washing machine, and geyser repairs.
- **Vehicle & Car Rentals**: Everyday AC cars (5-seater and 7-seater), outstation cabs, and luxury decorated wedding cars with professional chauffeurs.
- **Home Salon & Beauty**: At-home haircuts, facials, cleanups, bridal and party makeup, manicure, pedicure, and waxing.
- **House Help & Repairs**: Background-verified maids, full home deep cleaning, home cooks, babysitters, elder care attendants, electricians, and plumbers.
- **Home Tuition & Coaching**: Personalized 1-on-1 home tuition for school academics (Class 1-10), senior secondary (Class 11-12), and competitive exams.

## Service Areas
- Pan-India Service Network across Major Metros and Tier-1/2 Cities (Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Pune, Patna, Lucknow, Ahmedabad, and expanding nationwide).
